judgment_calls.decision: Possible TB diagnosis rule from TB symptoms (cough, weight loss, night sweats, fever), TB contact or abnormal screening CXR; the urgent check task and priority rule key off it.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Anchor priority directly on cough/fever; rejected because the page's box applies to 'suspected TB'.

judgment_calls.decision: PLHIV (at diagnosis/re-engagement/yearly/antenatal) and DS-TB in last 2 years not encoded: the timing schedule cannot be expressed and encoding the bare condition would flag TB at every visit.
judgment_calls.alternatives: (active_condition HIV) or History of tuberculosis as possible-TB evidence; fires far more often than intended.

judgment_calls.decision: TB on urine LAM, MTB detected (NAAT positive/trace), INH-resistant TB and RR-TB diagnoses not encoded: they depend on lab results (NAAT, LAM, DST, CD4) the language cannot record.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Use 'Rifampicin resistant tuberculosis'/'Isoniazid resistant tuberculosis' disorders as evidence; circular, so not done.
